How it works

From order to first session

  1. 01

    Pick a size

    From the 1-person Mini, Rainier and Shasta to the 5-person Kilimanjaro. Cabins come in Canadian hemlock or Canadian red cedar; the outdoor models have a black space-grade aluminum exterior.

  2. 02

    It ships free, in a crate

    In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days. The carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to book a 4-hour window.

  3. 03

    Plug it in

    The Mini, Rainier and Shasta run on a standard 120V/15A outlet, no electrician needed. The Fuji and Everest need a dedicated 120V/20A outlet. Outdoor models need a 240V outdoor-rated circuit and an electrician.

  4. 04

    Join Peak Wellness Club

    Included free with every PEAK: expert protocols with the temperature, duration and timing for each, a streak leaderboard and a private owner community.

Pricing

$4,950 to $16,750

From the 2-person Crown at $4,950 to the 4-person El Capitan at $16,750. Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout. PEAK saunas may be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo.
